status_vocabulary.observed: Measured from data and published with an uncertainty.
status_vocabulary.inferred: Obtained from data through a model fit (e.g. dynamical TTV mass).
status_vocabulary.derived: Computed from other quantities by a cited relation.
status_vocabulary.synthetic: Invented for this numerical experiment (Planet X only).
status_vocabulary.numerical: A property of the integration, not of nature (e.g. timestep).

orbital_period_days.rationale: Only source covering all 8 planets with a single self-consistent solution.

semi_major_axis_au.rationale: Published by Weiss et al. It equals (M* P_yr^2)^(1/3) to 1e-9 (CHECK 1b): the 4 pi^2 shortcut with the stellar mass alone. A derived quantity, not a measurement, and NOT used by the simulation, which derives a from the period and the total mass.

planet_radius_earth.rationale: Transit depth x stellar radius; same source as the orbital solution.

eccentricity.rationale: Weiss et al. fix e = 0 for all planets (no uncertainties quoted). Treated as an ADOPTED MODELLING ASSUMPTION, not a measurement. Measured values exist for g and h only and are recorded as alternates.

inclination_deg.rationale: Cabrera et al. for b-h; Shallue & Vanderburg 2018 for i. CROSS-SOURCE: flagged.

transit_epoch_bjd.rationale: Cabrera et al. for b-h; Shallue & Vanderburg 2018 for i. Sets orbital phase. CROSS-SOURCE: flagged.
